a. (-मी f.) [भीमस्य नृपस्येदम् अण्] 
__1 Relating to Bhīma. 
__2 Doing valorous deeds (भीमकर्मकर्तारः); [[

.]] 
-मी 
__1 ‘The daughter of Bhīma’, a patronymic of Damayantī, wife of [[Nala.]] 
__2 The eleventh day of the bright half of Māgha or a festival performed on that day. 
__3 A descendant of Bhīma; आत्तायुधं मामिह रौहिणेय पश्यन्तु भैमा युधि जातहर्षाः [[
